reason: A runtime localization utility for DeepSeek Harness that translates model-visible prompts, contexts, tool metadata, and optionally plugin marketplace descriptions into Chinese without modifying DSH source code.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供运行时中文本地化，将系统提示词、上下文、工具描述及可选的插件市场描述翻译成中文。
summaries.en: A runtime localization plugin for DeepSeek Harness that translates system prompts, contexts, tool descriptions, and optionally plugin marketplace descriptions into Chinese.

capabilities: Translates runtime system prompt sections, contexts, tool descriptions, and parameter descriptions into Chinese
Optionally intercepts plugin marketplace fetch responses to translate plugin descriptions
Optionally calls a registered translation endpoint and caches translated descriptions in localStorage
Preserves documented machine protocol markers and code identifiers while translating text
